schematictotem.cleared: Totems use their normal model again.

schematictotem.list.header: %s schematic files (click one to use it):
schematictotem.list.empty: No schematic files in schematics/. Drop a .litematic file onto the game window, or open the folder with /totemmodel folder.
schematictotem.list.hover: Use this file for the totem

schematictotem.info.waiting: (built the first time a totem is shown)
schematictotem.info.settings: Quad budget %s, tint biome %s, other entities %s
schematictotem.info.gui: Settings screen: /totemmodel gui, or the Config button in Mod Menu.
schematictotem.unnamed.missing: No schematic is bound to the name "%s"
schematictotem.pose.head: Worn on the head
schematictotem.screen.title: Schematic Totem
schematictotem.screen.no_file: No schematic selected yet. Use the button above, or drop a .litematic file onto the game window.
schematictotem.screen.general_hint: Quad budget, culling, block entities and glow rebuild the model in the background right after a change.
schematictotem.screen.preview_hint: Drag to turn · scroll to zoom · double-click resets. Detail changes rebuild after half a second.
schematictotem.screen.world_hint: Watch the game behind for hand poses; switch the view below

schematictotem.screen.hint_preview: Switch the preview box to this context to see it.
schematictotem.screen.drop_hint: You can also drop .litematic / .schem / .nbt files onto the game window
schematictotem.screen.pose_in_use: ✔ The totem in your hand uses this pose

schematictotem.screen.pose_unused: No totem in hand, or not visible from this view

schematictotem.full_heavy: Exact detail: %s quads at the finest level; holding it may cost frames
